field_principles.field_provenance: Every field names this module and the requirement.

field_principles.honest_verdict: The verdict uses a terminal prefix and states no solve credit.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The artifact states whether a model was loaded.
field_principles.level_credit_delta: Bare zero prevents public-fixture credit inflation.
field_principles.main_and_interaction_effects: Main effects and pair interaction are reported or marked unrun.
field_principles.matched_baseline_single_and_pair_configs: Baseline, singles, and pair configs are frozen together.
field_principles.model_specs: The only admissible inducer is the Exp6212 Gemma4-31B Q4_K_M runtime.
field_principles.paired_clustered_intervals: Intervals use game as the paired cluster.
field_principles.portfolio_ready_score: Readiness is capped by the two-eligible-lever gate.
field_principles.preregistered_heldout_game_seed_matrix: Held-out fixtures open only after two levers qualify.
field_principles.protected_files_unchanged: Conductor and reconciliation-owned files stay byte-identical.
field_principles.quality_efficiency_and_cost_by_arm_game: Quality, efficiency, and cost stay visible by lever.
field_principles.registry_precheck_and_hash_before_after: The solve registry is hash-bound and unchanged.
field_principles.registry_update_count: Bare zero proves the solve registry was not updated.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: A stable checksum catches silent artifact drift.
field_principles.selected_levers: The portfolio may contain at most two selected treatments.
field_principles.selection_rule_frozen_before_heldout: The pair rule is fixed before any held-out cells open.
field_principles.solve_claimed: The experiment makes no ARC solve claim.
field_principles.source_bfs_adapter_registry_hidden_state: Forbidden source, BFS, adapter, registry, and hidden-state reads are bare zeros.
field_principles.status: The terminal state separates a skip from a pair run.
field_principles.structured_skip_reason: A skip records why no model was loaded.
field_principles.test_commands: Verification commands are recorded with the artifact.
field_principles.test_exit_codes: Exit codes prevent unchecked test claims.
field_principles.treatment_fire_counts: A non-firing upstream treatment cannot enter the portfolio.
field_principles.upstream_paths_hashes_and_recomputed_gat: Each upstream lever is reclassified from artifact fields and hashes.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False because this is eligibility logic, not hidden-game oracle scoring.
